title: Normalize uppercase t-string prefixes in preview mode
body:
### Description

Fixes #5424. In preview mode, `T"hello"` now becomes `t"hello"`, and raw t-string prefixes retain the existing `r`/`R` case and ordering rules. Stable formatting and `--skip-string-normalization` are unchanged.

Following the maintainer feedback on the closed #5185, this adds a `Preview.normalize_tstring_prefix` feature and makes the mode argument required at both active normalization call sites. Thanks to @JSap0914 for the earlier work and the maintainers for clarifying the intended scope. The preview documentation and generated configuration schema include the feature.

Regression fixtures exercise all ten valid t-string prefix spellings in preview, stable and skipped-normalization modes. The preview fixture fails before the fix; both control fixtures already pass.

Validation on Python 3.14.6:
- Full non-Jupyter suite: **493 passed, 1 skipped, 8 subtests passed** (`env -u NO_COLOR python -m pytest tests --run-optional no_jupyter -q -n 4`). The shell exports `NO_COLOR=1`, which must be removed for the existing color-output tests.
- Mypy: all 42 source files pass; Black self-format, isort, flake8, documentation example checks and `git diff --check` pass.
- Sphinx documentation build with warnings treated as errors passes.
- Jupyter-specific tests and diff-shades were not run locally.

AI disclosure: prepared and tested by OpenAI Codex acting on behalf of @saitakarcesme. No independent human review is claimed.
